sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa

findings.why: Drawing Rev C is in force and requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa (SC-01). Alluminio B offers 6061-T6, which is the wrong grade. Its 240 MPa minimum is also below 250 MPa. Elena's mail uses the old Rev A/B values from the superseded drawing (DWG-BR220-RevB, withdrawn 2026-06-01), so it is outdated and cannot support the change.

sources.quote: 5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The drawing requires a 3.1 certificate with each lot. No certificate or test result is in the documents for the 6061-T6 bar that Alluminio B proposes to ship this week. A person must say whether one exists and what it shows.
